rules: Provided by trusted host, not accepted from model tool arguments.
Deadline is inherited by dependent calls; never reset it.
Cancellation stops new effects, preserves committed/unknown writes and releases only owned resources.
Credentials stay in host transport; never return them in payloads.

compatibility: v1 schemas are canonical. Changes to required fields, enums, nullability or effect semantics require explicit revision and all consumer fixture updates.
composition: foundation injects service ports and registers public tools; features never import foundation or sibling internals. Optional drivers call a project-cli executor primitive; project-cli does not import preview/story, preventing cycles.
